question: How many years has the Net Profit Attributable to Shareholders exceeded 80,000,000?

steps.description: Locate the visual representation of 'Net Profit Attributable to Shareholders' on the graph
Identify the threshold mark on the Y-axis for comparison
Compare each year's bar height from 2012 to 2024 against the Y-axis threshold
Count the number of years where the bar extends beyond the threshold
